title: FeedLists
description: The news feed lists a household can turn on, one row per list: the bundled package that carries its feeds, a plain-words label, the user types it is offered to and the ones that start with it on. A user type not in offered_for never gets the list, whatever an admin setting says. The feeds themselves live in the list's package (feed-list-package.schema.json), never here.

version.description: The review month of this policy, such as 2026.10.

package_id.description: The bundled module package that carries this list's feeds.

does.description: One plain-words line, shown beside the list's name.

offered_for.description: User types this list may ever reach. The settings key for any other user type does not offer it and the hub ignores it if stored.

default_for.description: User types that start with this list on. Always a subset of offered_for.
